name: nc/offcanvas
title: Off-canvas
description: Trigger button that opens a side panel holding child blocks. The panel is a modal dialog.
aiHints: settings.label is the trigger text and is required; an empty label outputs nothing. settings.side is left or right, default left. settings.width is a CSS length such as 20rem, 320px or 80vw, default 20rem. Child blocks go inside the panel. The panel is hidden until the trigger is pressed.
